description: This PHP source file implements server-side logic for retrieving and constructing a hierarchical tree structure of test project nodes, including projects, test suites, and test cases, for use in a web-based interface with Ext JS. It handles AJAX requests, fetches data from database tables, and prepares JSON-encoded node data with navigation and interaction details.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Utility class for database table management and retrieval.

methods.name: display_children
methods.description: Fetches and structures child nodes (projects, test suites, test cases) under a given parent node, with options for filtering, node types, and operation modes.

methods.name: getAllTCasesID
methods.description: Recursively gathers all test case node IDs under specified test suites and nodes, populating a provided array.
